evidence.quote: The Electrical Engineering and Information Technology course lasts seven semesters
Since the program is taught in English, you must demonstrate sufficient English proficiency.
Will the program be held completely in English? Yes, except for the classes to learn German.
Tuition fee for international students €1,500.00 per semester
International students are students who are not citizens of a member state of the European Union or another signatory state to the Agreement on the European Economic Area.
Step 1 Register on the THU application portal and submit your application.

In addition, you must submit a completed form regarding your German language proficiency, a statement of purpose (explaining your motivation to study Electrical Engineering and Information Technology at THU), your resume, and a copy of your passport.
If you are unable to upload your school certificate by July 15th, you should submit all other documents in time and submit the certificate as part of the coordinated succession procedure.

notes: Teaching language: English; German is a compulsory subject and language modules, but the programme is taught in English (FAQ says completely in English except German classes). Duration: 7 semesters = 3.5 years. Tuition: EUR 1,500 per semester is stated for international students at THU (non-EU/EEA); the DAAD page entry 'non-EU countries 650 EUR' appears under 'second degree' fees and is not used here. Intakes: the programme's own page gives 'Application period 28. April - 15. Juli' (winter semester) — no year stated, so the deadline is emitted without a year; 'Winter semester approx. mid-April - July 15' is the university's restriction for this programme (EET is listed as admission-restricted). Application channel: pages point to the THU application portal (university direct), not uni-assist; recognition of foreign diplomas is via Studienkolleg Konstanz, so de-uni-assist-vpd does not apply. English scores differ between pages (DAAD: TOEFL 79/IELTS 6; THU FAQ: TOEFL 72/IELTS 5.5) — listed as manual check.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEFL iBT Home Edition (before 2026): 79 Cambridge English Qualifications: B2 First IELTS Academic: 6
Since the program is taught in English, you must demonstrate sufficient English proficiency.

note.fr: Vérifiez les scores d'anglais acceptés (TOEFL/IELTS/Cambridge) sur la page « Application for International Students » : selon la page, les scores varient (par ex. TOEFL 72/79, IELTS 5.5/6).
note.en: Check the accepted English scores (TOEFL/IELTS/Cambridge) on the 'Application for International Students' page: the pages give differing scores (e.g. TOEFL 72/79, IELTS 5.5/6).

evidence.quote: We accept: TOEFL (a score of 72 or higher) IELTS (a score of 5.5 or higher) Cambridge Certificate (a score of 160-180, B2 first, grade B)
B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEFL iBT Home Edition (before 2026): 79 Cambridge English Qualifications: B2 First IELTS Academic: 6

note.fr: Diplôme étranger : faire reconnaître le diplôme par le Studienkolleg Konstanz (pas uni-assist). L'admission dépend du nombre de places (NC) ; processus et dates sur le site.
note.en: Foreign diploma: have your diploma recognised by Studienkolleg Konstanz (not uni-assist). Admission depends on the number of places (NC); see website for process and dates.

evidence.quote: If you hold a foreign high school diploma, you must have your diploma recognized by the Studienkolleg Konstanz.
Can the recognition of the secondary school leaving certificate be done by Uni-assist rather than Studienkolleg Konstanz? This is not possible since we do not have a contract with Uni-assist.
Applicants must therefore go through a selection procedure.
What is the grade required for admission? We do have a numerus clausus.
